Plan only — nothing was modified (working tree clean at `eab3c41`, branch `ship/run-request-9b03e6202f…`); no PR opened. ## What the repo actually looks like (verified) The site is three files, no build step, no JS, no images anywhere: - `/work/index.html` — nav (lines 10–13: `Home`, `About`), `
` with `h1` (line 15), `.tagline` (16), intro `

` (17), footer (19–21). The "hero" is just the `h1` + tagline + intro paragraph; there is no dedicated hero element or hero image. - `/work/about.html` — same skeleton; not touched by this plan. - `/work/styles.css` — 4 rules, 249 bytes: `body` (Georgia serif, `max-width: 40rem`, centered → the whole site is a ~640px single column), `nav a`, `footer` (1px `#999` top border), `.tagline` (italic). - No `images/` dir, no ``, no `gallery`/`photo` references in any file (`grep` returned nothing). - History note: the recent-history context mentions merged-looking `contact.html` and "Our story" PRs, but this branch has only the seed commit — nav still reads `Home`/`About` and there is no `contact.html`. Those PRs are evidently unmerged relative to this branch. Low conflict risk (they touch nav/title, we'd touch `

` + CSS tail), but ordering is worth deciding. ## Assumptions 1. "Hero" = the `h1`/tagline/intro block; the gallery is inserted between line 17 (`

`) and line 18 (`
`), home page only. 2. "Photo card" = semantic `` — no divs, no JS. 3. All styling goes in the existing `styles.css`, scoped under a `.gallery` class so `about.html` (which shares the stylesheet but has no `.gallery`) is provably unaffected. 4. Pages stay hand-authored static HTML, UTF-8, 2-space indent, matching existing conventions; the home `` stays exactly `Tideline Woodworks`. 5. Some image asset must exist at the end — I assume three real photos will be supplied by you (biggest open question, below). ## Scoped steps 1. **Assets.** Add three photos under a new `images/` directory, lowercase-hyphen filenames (e.g. `images/table-driftwood.jpg`), each ideally ≤ ~150 KB JPEG. 2. **`index.html`.** One insertion after the intro paragraph: `<section class="gallery">` containing an optional visible `<h2>` and three `<figure class="card">` with `<img src loading="lazy" decoding="async" width height alt="…">` + `<figcaption>`. No other lines touched — nav, footer, `<head>` unchanged. 3. **`styles.css`.** Append ~12–15 lines scoped to `.gallery`: responsive grid (`grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(10rem, 1fr))`), gap, `figure { margin: 0 }`, small italic `figcaption` echoing `.tagline`, optional `#999` border echoing the footer. Nothing rewritten. 4. **Verify, don't ship.** Acceptance pass below; commit/PR only after your explicit follow-up authorization. ## Acceptance checks - `index.html` has exactly one `.gallery` section containing exactly three `<figure>` elements, each with one `<img>` carrying a non-empty `alt`, explicit `width`/`height`, and one `<figcaption>`. - Section sits after the intro `<p>` and before `</main>`; `nav`, `<footer>`, `<head>` byte-identical (`git diff` shows only the one insertion). - `git diff --stat`: only `index.html` + `styles.css` modified, `images/` added, `about.html` unchanged. - All three `src` paths resolve: serve with `python3 -m http.server` and confirm no 404s; grep confirms no absolute/external URLs. - Tags balanced (parse with Python's `html.parser`); file remains valid UTF-8. - CSS additions all start with `.gallery` (`grep '^[^.]' styles.css` diff-clean outside it), so `about.html` rendering is unchanged by construction. - Cards wrap to one column on narrow viewports (reasoned from `auto-fit`; a true headless-browser check isn't available in this sandbox). ## Tradeoffs, plainly - **Three-across vs. responsive wrap:** fixed 3 columns look tidy on desktop but become ~180px thumbnails inside the 40rem column on a phone. Responsive `auto-fit` costs one slightly fancier line of CSS and looks good everywhere — recommended. - **Real photos vs. placeholders vs. empty `src`:** committing JPEGs permanently grows the repo but is the only option that passes acceptance; locally generated placeholders keep the layout reviewable until you supply real photos; leaving `src` pointing at nonexistent files would ship broken images — rejected. - **Visible `<h2>` vs. heading-less section:** a heading ("From the workshop"?) improves document outline and screen-reader navigation at the cost of one more line on the page. Recommend including it. - **Shared stylesheet vs. inline styles:** shared CSS matches every existing convention; the only risk is cross-page impact, which the `.gallery` scoping removes. - **`width`/`height` on `<img>`:** two extra attributes per card that prevent layout jump while loading — cheap win. ## Open questions (blocking or preference) 1. **Photo source:** will you supply the three images (and their filenames/captions/alt text), or should placeholders be generated? This is the only genuinely blocking unknown. 2. Visible section heading — include one? If so, preferred wording. 3. Should cards be static, or link somewhere (enlarged view / detail pages)? Plan assumes static. 4. Always-3-across or responsive wrapping? Plan assumes responsive. 5. Ordering vs. the unmerged `contact.html` / nav-rename PRs in the history — independent, but if you want one review order, say which lands first. FINDINGS_JSON []
